reactions.name: usr_CO_OH
reactions.__description: CAM mo_usrrxt.F90 usr_CO_OH; JPL 19-5 Table 2-2 row K3, a chemical-activation reaction: k = k_f(T,[M]) + k_int(T)*(1 - k_f(T,[M])/k_inf(T)), k_f being a standard Troe association rate constant (k0_298=6.9e-33, n=2.1, k_inf_298=1.1e-12, m=-1.3, Fc=0.6, N=1) and k_int(T)=A*exp(-B/T) with A=1.85e-13, B=65. No MICM reaction type can represent this exactly (TROE and TERNARY_CHEMICAL_ACTIVATION were checked and ruled out; confirmed both algebraically and numerically). Needs a new CHEMICAL_ACTIVATION reaction type in MICM. Set to scaling factor 0.0 (no effect) until that is implemented.
